# Current skill evidence does not establish a complete spec-to-impl consumer handoff

## Situation and impact

Current skill evidence does not establish a complete spec-to-impl consumer handoff. This work serves the approved North Star goal of less consumer rework and faster correct development.

## Current slice and scope

skills/public/spec, skills/public/impl, docs/public-skill-dogfood.json and existing dogfood/probe artifacts.

Run an isolated installed-layout baseline with a real small repository and concrete feature request. Pass the produced spec to a fresh implementation context, introduce one discoverable constraint, inspect behavior and fix demonstrated rework at its owning skill. Repeat the identical input with candidate skills.

## Acceptance and verification

Retain input and revision identity, produced spec, patch, actual test output and independent acceptance dispositions. Preserve existing behavior, synchronize discovered constraints, avoid user-context repetition. Report preservation where baseline already succeeds.

## Execution contract

- Dependencies: contract-ownership; local deliverable readiness unlocks work
